| # | Date | Part | Topic |
|--:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Wed 23/09 | [Intro]{.part .part-gen} [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Course overview, logistics and exam; receding horizon, nominal MPC and its properties, pseudo-code and notation |
| 2 | Thu 24/09 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | MPC in practice: centralized and decentralized, the two time indices, first example, state space models |
| 3 | Mon 28/09 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | The general MPC problem; infinite-horizon constrained control, LQR and its optimal cost |
| 4 | Wed 30/09 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Why MPC is optimal: dual mode control and the value function |
| 5 | Thu 01/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Conclusions on optimality; first case study: the EV charging service area |
| 6 | Mon 05/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Service area: final formulation and Julia code; losses and indicator variables |
| 7 | Wed 07/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | End of the service area example; recursive feasibility |
| 8 | Thu 08/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Proving recursive feasibility; stability, first definitions |
| 9 | Mon 12/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Stability of MPC: Lyapunov theory |
| 10 | Wed 14/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Stability of MPC: the optimal cost as Lyapunov function |
| 11 | Thu 15/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | The role of the MPC ingredients; economic MPC; second case study: the building |
| 12 | Mon 19/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Building: shiftable loads, the electricity bill, battery ageing |
| 13 | Wed 21/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | End of the building case study; tuning and the Pareto frontier; large-scale EV charging |
| 14 | Thu 22/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | End of the large-scale charging example; MPC for traffic control |
| 15 | Mon 26/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} | Task scheduling in an assembly line; logical constraints at work |
| 16 | Wed 28/10 | [MPC]{.part .part-mpc} [RL]{.part .part-rl} | End of task scheduling; introduction to RL: agent, reward and return, policy, value function |
| 17 | Thu 29/10 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | MDPs, value functions, Bellman equations |
| 18 | Mon 02/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Dynamic programming: policy and value iteration; numerical experiment |
| 19 | Wed 04/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Monte Carlo and temporal-difference methods; Q-learning |
| 20 | Thu 05/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Function approximation and deep RL (DDPG) |
| 21 | Mon 09/11 | [RL]{.part .part-rl} | Hybrid MPC–RL algorithms; learning the weights and the terminal cost of an MPC |
| 22 | Wed 11/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Introduction to identification; statistical estimators and their properties |
| 23 | Thu 12/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Linear and weighted least squares; regularization |
| 24 | Mon 16/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Maximum likelihood, Bayesian estimation, Cramér–Rao bound, nonlinear least squares |
| 25 | Wed 18/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Recursive least squares; dynamic models (ARX, output error), predictors |
| 26 | Thu 19/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Prediction error methods; experiment design; model validation |
| 27 | Mon 23/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Lab: full identification workflow on real data |
| 28 | Wed 25/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Kalman filter, EKF, moving horizon estimation |
| 29 | Thu 26/11 | [ID]{.part .part-id} | Data-driven predictive control (Willems' lemma, DeePC); time series and advanced methods |
| 30 | Mon 30/11 | [Wrap-up]{.part .part-gen} | Course recap, exam information, identify-then-control demo |
